rationale: Both FP32 and E1 dynamic INT8 pass the >=70% canonical floor on eval, but E1 trades away accuracy, TF-fidelity, and latency for smaller size. FP32 is selected as the default to prioritize quality/fidelity and responsiveness for chemistry_draw; E1 remains a recorded non-selected alternative if size is prioritized.

e1_dynamic_int8_all.note: Passes floor but worse quality/fidelity and ~2.6x slower p50 (dynamic INT8 not guaranteed faster on CPU)

rejected_or_not_selected.E1_dynamic_int8_all: Meets >=70% but lower canonical (-1.51pp), lower TF fidelity (-5.4pp), and ~2.6x slower than FP32; not selected as default
